files.content: function even(a:(i32|undefined)[],i:u32,n:i32):i32|undefined{if(n===0){return a[i];}return odd(a,i,n-1);} function odd(a:(i32|undefined)[],i:u32,n:i32):i32|undefined{if(n===0){return a[i];}return even(a,i,n-1);} export function read(a:(i32|undefined)[],i:u32,n:i32):i32|undefined{return even(a,i,n);}
export function run():(i32|undefined)[]{const a:(i32|undefined)[]=[undefined,1];const b=[a[1]];return b;}
export function run(flag:boolean):i32|undefined{const a:(i32|undefined)[]=[1,undefined];let i:u32=0;flag&&((i=1)===1);return a[i];}
